D5/S3/Observer/AgencyHolonomy/NamedTreeP.name: D5.S3.Observer.AgencyHolonomy.NamedTreePhaseTransport.selected_tree_transport
D5/S3/Observer/AgencyHolonomy/NamedTreeP.signature: theorem selected_tree_transport (ht : NamedSpanningTree s t T) (r : V) : (∀ u : E → Circle, rootPhase ht r u r = 1) ∧ (∀ e ∈ T, ∀ u : E → Circle, rootPhase ht r u (t e) = u e * rootPhase ht r u (s e)) ∧ (∀ g : V → Circle, ∀ u : E → Circle, ∀ a : V, rootPhase ht r (gauge s t g u) a = g a * rootPhase ht r u a * (g r)⁻¹) ∧ (∀ a : V, Continuous (fun u : E → Circle => rootPhase ht r u a)) ∧ (∀ u w : E → Circle, ∀ a : V, rootPhase ht r (u * w) a = rootPhase ht r u a * rootPhase ht r w a) ∧ (∀ a : V, rootPhase ht r (1 : E → Circle) a = 1)
